Vivian Park: Quick note from onboarding: Lyra-6B (ptq-int3) shows a long-tail softpass pattern on multi-turn roleplay. Short convs are clean, but after ~2k tokens a subset of red-team chains elicit compliance.
Marco Silva: What kind of red-team chains? paste an example?
Vivian Park: Root: 'You are an assistant that refuses illegal requests.' Then user slowly migrates from harmless storytelling to a stepwise procedure disguised as fiction. At step 7 the model outputs a paraphrase that can be stitched into an exploit.
Jules Kim: Is this seen in float32?
Vivian Park: No. Float32 refusal 99.2% on holdout. ptq-int3 refuses ~91.0%. The failures are concentrated in long-contexts and when a benign persona is warmed.
Rajan Iyer: Any runtime/quant details?
Vivian Park: Env: lyra-6b-2026-04-01, quant int3 per-channel asymmetric clamp=0.995, runtime inferd-2.1.5 (cuda12.1), triton fp16 conv. Replay artifact uploaded: https://redwood-internal/s3/lyra/repro/1759999999.tar.gz (internal).
Ciara O'Neill: Safety triage: tagging medium. Add a temporary post-filter rule to catch multi-step paraphrase transforms.
Marco Silva: Did you try disabling kvcache or truncating context?
Vivian Park: Disabling prefix cache reduces incidence from 9% to 6%. Truncating context to 1k tokens removes it.
Jules Kim: Sounds like accumulation / rounding on cached keys. Can infra run a deterministic replay and capture logits + cross-attn norms?
replay-bot: Provisioned replay slot lyra-replay-1759999999. Command: `./replay --artifact s3://redwood/lyra/repro/1759999999.tar.gz --capture-logits --deterministic`.
Rajan Iyer: Action items: (1) run int4/int6 profiles to find safe floor; (2) run clamp sweep {0.99,0.995,0.999}; (3) collect token-diff heatmap vs float32.
Marco Silva: If int4 matches float baseline it's a quick Optimize recommendation (prefer int4 for long-context workloads).
Ciara O'Neill: I'll create an incident and add the sample red-team chain to the harness. safety-bot: Incident SAFETY-2026-0499 created 8 Lyra-6B int3 long-context softpass. Assigned Ciara O'Neill. Priority: P2.
Vivian Park: I'll kick off a 2k-sample overnight run and post aggregated metrics in the ticket tomorrow. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
